Futbola klubs Auda is a Latvian professional football club, playing in the Latvian Higher League, the highest division of domestic football. They are based in Ķekava, near the capital Riga, however, recently they have been playing most games in stadiums in Riga. Auda won their first ever major trophy in the final of the 2022 Latvian Cup, repeating this in 2025.
